subject: Re: Thursday — Bedford departure
body:
Hi Morgan,

No problem at all. Unfortunately a 6:00pm departure from Bedford would put our crew 13 minutes over their legal duty limit, so we can't do exactly that as things stand. Here are the options that work:

A) Depart BED at 5:45pm (arrive PBI 8:28pm), same crew. Change fee: $500.
B) Depart BED at 6:00pm (arrive PBI 8:43pm) as requested, and move the morning TEB→BED departure from 8:00am to 8:15am (arrive BED 8:55am) so the crew starts later. Change fee: $1,000 ($500 per leg).
C) Depart BED at 6:00pm (arrive PBI 8:43pm) as requested with a different crew. This includes a $500 departure change fee plus a $2,500 crew swap charge, $3,000 total.

Which would you prefer? Once you confirm, we'll update the Bedford handling, catering and Palm Beach arrangements accordingly.

Best regards,
Larkhaven Air operations team
